pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: A stylish late-night street-food diner on a city corner, a glowing counter window with a chrome edge, steam rising from the kitchen, a brown paper take-away bag and a long curling paper order ticket on the counter, a cook in a dark apron and cap working behind the window, the street quiet and atmospheric, wide landscape picture for a title card, the diner in the middle.

pictures.name: back-diner
pictures.prompt: Inside a stylish modern diner kitchen at night, seen straight on from the customer side: a long steel counter across the bottom, a dark tiled wall behind with a glowing order rail and a few hanging pans near the edges, warm lights, the middle of the wall plain and calm so things placed on top stand out. Empty background scenery, no people, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bag
pictures.prompt: One plain brown paper take-away bag standing upright, seen straight on from the front, a wide flat empty front face with no print, the top folded over twice, crisp gentle creases, slightly rounded corners. Single object, centred, the whole bag visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: ticket
pictures.prompt: One long blank paper order ticket from a diner, a tall narrow strip of off-white paper with a gently torn zigzag bottom edge and a small curl at the bottom, completely blank with no writing and no lines, seen straight on. Single object, centred, the whole ticket visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: chef
pictures.prompt: A cool young diner cook, a confident teenage-looking character in a dark apron, rolled sleeves and a backwards cap, a pencil behind one ear, one hand raised pointing upward as if explaining something, a relaxed half smile, full body, facing the viewer. Single character, centred, the whole body visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.
